note: An RPN calculator on the console, decnumber underneath; it reads a number or ENTER + - * / POW quit per line and prints the stack after each operation. The row types the example of its own header, (35 ENTER 5 +) 10 /, and expects X = 4. Its main returns EXIT_OS_SUCCESS, which kills the console process (OS/Includes/exit_codes.h), so the calculator keeps the console for good: 'quit' ends the calculator and leaves the board without a console until a reset.
